notes:
A new Cover size setting, and a much clearer Sync screen.

**Choose how big the covers are.** Library menu → **Cover size**, from 2 per row up to 6. It applies straight away, so you can judge it against your own covers. Your current view is "4 per row", exactly as before.

**The Sync screen has been rebuilt.** It is now a single panel in the middle of the screen with much larger, plainer wording, instead of a full page of small text.

**You can see a sync actually happening.** Once the two tablets connect, both of them show what is going on and a progress bar that fills — before, the tablet that did not start the sync just sat there showing the device list, and the tablet that was sending never showed progress at all. There is a clear Cancel button, so you cannot wander back to the Library by accident mid-sync. Cancelling asks first, because a sync that is stopped part-way has to be run again from the start.

**While the second tablet is receiving a piece, its logo turns** so you can see something is happening, and the progress panel no longer sits on top of it.

**Covers no longer appear zoomed in** after changing the cover size.

**Composer names and book contents now reach the Samsung tablet**, so it shows the same information this one does.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
